title: Inbox
description: A project's inbox, as .agentic-task-manager/inbox.json and inbox-archive.json keep it (docs/inbox-design.md §2, ATM-759): the user's raw input, each item created, then discarded with a reason or injected into the tasks made from it.

next.description: The next item's number: a number is never given twice

text.description: Markdown, as task text renders; at most 20,000 characters

reason.description: Discarded only: why, at most 500 characters

tasks.description: Injected only: the keys of the tasks made from it, at least one; each task's from names the item back

created_by.description: Who added it: a person (an agent can't)

updated_by.description: Who changed it last (an edit or a restore)

decided_at.description: ISO 8601, when it was discarded or injected

renumbered_from.description: The number a merge took from it, when both branches gave it to different items: theirs moved to the next free one
